name: dumbbell flat flye hold
description: A static hold at the bottom of a flat flye. It builds chest tension and control in the stretched position.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms wide with soft elbows until the dumbbells are level with your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and your feet planted.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the weights drop.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest and set them down carefully.
